tasks.title: Deliver exact authorized Configuration binding editor context
tasks.acceptanceCriteria: Deliver one finite optional read-only Configuration binding-editor context for the exact visible application/configuration/schema and selected Common or Application source. Resolve the actual enabled binding and immutable definition plus at most two actual source slots in one qualified clean snapshot; preserve historical source semantics elsewhere. Independently authorize actual binding and each disclosed source; selected defaults require actual source ContentRead. Explicitly distinguish absent, redacted, disabled/unavailable and unsupported, preserving exact schema/default JSON bytes and bounds without a fleet scan, manifest disclosure, nested ObjectDefaults template exposure, invented empty object or merged-value authority. Reuse existing native backend, typed response/codecs/client and current security/cleanup owners. No mutation, new schema/package, Scheduler runtime or full editor delivery is claimed. This is the backend/client prerequisite of original164, whose author/review/publication/release obligations remain in the sibling.
tasks.validation: Use existing unit/canonical/native Management fixtures to prove exact application/environment/schema pairing, actual Common and Application binding sources, disabled retained sources, independently denied Common metadata and selected defaults, hidden/missing/unsupported targets, malformed optional backends, cancellation and true cleanup. Validate exact lexical defaults/shape and compatible bounded CSharp/TypeScript decoding/client echo checks; no all-fleet discovery or authorization by browser names. Include affected docs, scoped format and independent security review. Same original100 parent/shared allocation; no extra capacity.
